notes.title: Steam Trading Cards Now Live!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27202310/fcdda5f01234e7ab1996cae0d806ab1c55935e0a.png[/img]
Good news! Kamio Recoil now has Steam Trading Cards!

Just play the game to receive your free cards, and craft badges or unlock the cute new backgrounds and emoticons in the Steam Point Shop!
